profile_text.body:
Perplexity is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question.

The company's tracked products include Perplexity AI, a search-augmented large language model accessible via its main website, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, an enterprise-oriented offering that the site characterizes as covering internal knowledge search, data indexing, single sign-on, and audit logs. Perplexity also maintains a presence in the MCP server registry through two entries: one supporting real-time web search, reasoning, and research through its API, and another enabling AI assistants to perform web searches using its Sonar Pro model.

The held facts record nine active or recent legal cases involving Perplexity AI, Inc. Plaintiffs include Cable News Network Inc., The New York Times Company, Chicago Tribune Company LLC, Encyclopaedia Britannica Inc., and Amazon.com Services LLC, the last of which has proceedings in both the Northern District of California and the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Additional cases have been filed by parties identified as Gagleard and Noel in California federal courts. The site's data notes 174 legal exposure entries coded to California.
